title: EPILOGUE // THE BROKEN CHAIR
narrative: Drogon's breath washes over the thousand swords of Aegon's throne. Ancient Valyrian steel runs like liquid tallow across the flagstones. The throne that cost three centuries of blood is reduced to a puddle of slag. A council of free lords and smallfolk gathers in the ruins to establish a new charter. The Iron Throne is no more.
